name: Dreadnought Core

abilities.name: Bulwark Protocol
abilities.description: Reinforces plating, absorbing the next 50 incoming damage for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Dense Mass
abilities.description: Immune to pushback and stagger effects from lighter attacks.

flavorText: Engineered for front-line attrition, the Dreadnought Core sacrifices velocity for sheer survivability.

name: Phantom Skiff

abilities.name: Phase Shift
abilities.description: Shifts shell into a semi-corporeal state, gaining 50% evasion until the start of next turn.

abilities.name: Thermal Cloak
abilities.description: Cannot be targeted by lock-on abilities while above 50% energy.

flavorText: Crafted from composite metamaterials that scatter optical and sensor signatures.

name: Siegebreaker Arm

abilities.name: Tectonic Impact
abilities.description: Delivers a hydraulic slam dealing 70 blunt damage and shattering 10 armor.

abilities.name: Hydraulic Recoil
abilities.description: Melee counterattacks deal +15% bonus impact damage.

flavorText: Reinforced piston-driven arm built to breach bunker doors and heavy hull plating.

name: Arc Plasma Lance

abilities.name: Superheated Beam
abilities.description: Fires a searing beam penetrating all enemies in a 4-tile line, inflicting Burn.

abilities.name: Capacitor Vent
abilities.description: Vents residual heat to clear status effects and blind adjacent foes.

flavorText: Focuses unstable plasma into an ultra-dense spear capable of melting reinforced alloy.

name: Centipede Track Base

abilities.name: Anchor Stance
abilities.description: Locks magnetic clamps into terrain, preventing displacement and boosting firing accuracy by 20%.

abilities.name: Trench Grinder
abilities.description: Ignores movement penalties on rough, ruined, or toxic terrain.

flavorText: Segmented steel treads that crawl through cratered moonscapes and mud with ease.

name: Vector Hover Rig

abilities.name: Micro-Burst Dash
abilities.description: Instantly teleports / dashes 3 tiles in any direction, breaking free from locks.

abilities.name: Low-Altitude Hover
abilities.description: Glides cleanly over water, acid pools, and floor traps.

flavorText: Twin gimballed ion repulsors granting unmatched lateral speed and jump elevation.

name: Nanite Hive Pouch

abilities.name: Cellular Reconstitution
abilities.description: Deploys a cloud of nanobots to restore 40 HP to this shell or an allied construct.

abilities.name: Scrap Scavenger
abilities.description: Recover 10 Energy and 10 HP whenever an enemy construct within 3 tiles is destroyed.

flavorText: A miniature bioreactor housing millions of programmed nanobots ready to weld armor mid-combat.

name: Chrono-Aegis Projector

abilities.name: Temporal Stasis Ward
abilities.description: Places a temporal field around the shell for 1 turn; delayed projectile attacks freeze in mid-air.

abilities.name: Chrono-Reversion
abilities.description: Once per battle, on fatal damage, rewinds shell state to 25% HP and purges debuffs.

flavorText: An experimental field generator that bends the local fabric of spacetime to deter fatal strikes.
